core_obligations: For (1), note that X x_B Y -> Y is affine and that the graph (1, g) is a base change of the diagonal of Y, hence affine (proof lines 4133-4138).
Conclude that g, the composite of the graph with the projection, is affine (proof lines 4139-4140).
Derive (2) from (1) using that a closed immersion is affine and that separatedness of Y over B means the diagonal is a closed immersion (proof lines 4141-4143).
Identify (3) and (4) as the special cases of (1) and (2) for B = Spec(Z) and an affine scheme source (proof lines 4143-4144).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma with its four assertions about affineness of a morphism g : X -> Y of algebraic spaces over B: if X is affine over B and the diagonal of Y over B is affine (or Y is separated over B) then g is affine, and the same for a morphism from an affine scheme to an algebraic space with affine diagonal (source lines 4115-4130). The proof of (1) is a chain inside the span: the base change X x_B Y -> Y is affine, the graph (1, g) is the base change of the diagonal of Y, hence affine, and a composite of affine morphisms is affine; parts (2), (3) and (4) are then obtained from (1) and (2) using that a closed immersion is affine and that separatedness of Y over B says the diagonal is a closed immersion.
